families.label: APPLIED AI
families.blurb: LLM pipelines that are measured, budgeted and kept behind a human review step.

repos.name: affiliate-content-factory
repos.what: Turns affiliate offers into reviewed social posts, branded images and narrated Reels.
repos.stack: TypeScript monorepo · Fastify · Prisma/PostgreSQL · MCP server · local and hosted models
repos.decision: Every claim in generated copy must trace to a verified price or evidence record; nothing publishes without an approved package.

repos.name: aurea-web-app
repos.what: React front end of an AI growth operating system: business context, ICPs, goals, strategies, experiments, learnings.
repos.stack: React · TanStack Query · Kubb-generated client · Fastify API with agent runtime, budgets, tracing and Stripe credits
repos.decision: The agent runtime is metered per workspace and every AI fill is editable before it is saved.

frames.caption: Home with onboarding progress and recent activity.
Business profile and context sections.
Ideal customer profiles (2 ICPs).
Growth loop, Planos stage (1 active, 1 draft strategy).

families.label: E-COMMERCE
families.blurb: Community stores with Pix and card payments, campaigns, raffles and donations.

repos.name: ecommerce-storefront
repos.what: Web storefront for community stores: catalog, campaigns, raffles, donations, checkout.
repos.stack: React SSR on Cloudflare Workers · REST API (Fastify, Prisma) · Pix and card providers · Playwright e2e
repos.decision: Payments run through a provider adapter with a fake mode, so the full checkout is covered by end-to-end tests without real money.

families.label: LABOR CALCULATIONS
families.blurb: Brazilian labor-claim settlements, public calculators and docket sync.

repos.name: labor-calculations-web
repos.what: Public calculators plus a lawyer workspace: cases, dockets, deadlines, settlement figures.
repos.stack: React · generated API client · multi-tenant API with DataJud docket sync
repos.decision: Calculation rules live in one versioned domain module shared by the public calculators and the case workspace.

frames.caption: Landing with the public calculators
Severance calculator, 7-step form
Lawyer workspace: cases and deadlines
Case overview with settlement figures

families.label: AMBULANCE FLEET
families.blurb: Dispatch console, crew chat, push-to-talk radio and driver check-in.

repos.name: ambulance-fleet-dashboard
repos.what: Operator console: vehicle control, ambulances and documents, bases, crews and chats.
repos.stack: React · Orval-generated client · multi-tenant Fastify API · realtime channels · React Native crew and driver apps
repos.decision: One OpenAPI contract generates the clients for the console and both mobile apps, so a backend change breaks at build time, not in the field.

frames.caption: Ambulance control board (VTR status table, in-service/available meters, QAP/OCP/EVT/J4 chips).
Ambulance list with plate, unit, base, status selector.
Radio/chat conversation list with unread counts, no thread open.

families.label: FIELD OPERATIONS
families.blurb: Sessions, preparations and stock per unit and region, with role-based access.

repos.name: field-operations-tracker-web
repos.what: Read-only admin panel over field data: dashboard, stock, preparations, reports, sessions.
repos.stack: React · Firebase hosting · REST API · React Native field client · offline-first planting geotracker
repos.decision: The panel is read-only by design; every write goes through the mobile client where the operator is authenticated on device.

frames.caption: Dashboard: units, regions and stock at a glance
Stock per unit with movements
Preparations log per session
Reports by period and region
